Swap 也就是虚拟内存，当物理内存 (RAM) 不足时，Linux 系统会自动: Swap is virtual memory. When physical memory (RAM) is insufficient, Linux automatically swaps some idle memory data to a dedicated Swap space on disk to keep the system stable. Configuring Swap greatly prevents key services (such as MySQL, Nginx) from being force-killed due to out-of-memory (OOM).
